description_for_human: Data tools: SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, USAspending, GLEIF, website contact extraction.
description_for_model: Use to fetch federal contract opportunities (SAM.gov), SEC filings, federal awards (USAspending) and company LEI records (GLEIF) and website contact details (emails, phones, social links) as JSON via Apify actors. Pay per event, with no platform usage fee added. AI agents can pay per run through Apify agentic payments (x402, Skyfire) with no Apify account, or call the tools with an Apify API token, or through the Apify MCP server at https://mcp.apify.com. One-URL MCP endpoint for all tools: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP, Apify OAuth or Bearer Apify token).
